scope: Historically exposed development research. No milestone, test or complementary-test feedback.
endpoint: Official pooled SLU-F1; do not average per-row F1 as its substitute.
primary_final_contrast: Frozen L minus frozen B on the entire registered DEV roster
secondary_final_contrast: Frozen L minus frozen seed on that same roster
guards: actual model/tool contact counts and available token/time telemetry

resampling.unit: paired utterance; keep all recording variants together

reference: Freeze F_ref once from the initial seed official aggregate, on the zero-to-one scale.

search_selection.status: Sampling choice only, never scientific adoption
search_selection.frontier: Keep all non-dominated measurements on one exact common cohort; quality and intent higher, actual model/tool contacts lower.
search_selection.quality_parent: Among non-dominated candidates passing the own-A/A intent protection, prefer highest official SLU-F1, then intent, then fewer model contacts, then fewer tool contacts, then lexical bundle ID. If none qualifies, keep the parent.
search_selection.complementary_survivor: If available, keep a distinct non-dominated lower-cost candidate; tie-break by SLU-F1, intent, then lexical bundle ID. Retention is capped at two; preserve the full frontier in history.
search_selection.blind_rule: Keep blind proposals independent of every evaluator selection; expose no result or selected parent to B. B evaluation parent remains the seed in all three rounds.
search_selection.finalists: Choose L and B on the common TRAIN selection roster before any DEV result read, with identical quality/intent/cost tie-breaks. Retain all tested candidates and costs in the report.

read_gate: Freeze the complete admitted member-to-run mapping and any pre-contact invalid-proposal exclusions before each stage.
Require every admitted member FINALIZED, its exact roster and verified seal, and one unique complete official score. A manifest status alone is insufficient.
Stop on a failed admitted family. Do not convert post-contact failures into exclusions, fabricate feedback, retry automatically or substitute partial rows.
Countersign the stage-specific READ entry only after the complete-family gate. Root performs scientific interpretation.
Project L's own branch only after the whole stage is qualified. Recompute relative feedback inside L; never leak B scores through normalization.
Track feedback, proposal, knowledge construction, unused complementary inputs and selection exposure transitively. Reject future evaluation overlap at utterance level.
adoption: Require confidence intervals, intent protection, replication and the existing Stage-3 measurement floor. Point-estimate search retention is not adoption. Report uncertainty instead of extending the sample.
execution_admission: pending; this recipe is not a generation, scorer replay or scientific-read receipt
